title: KasirkuPOSFirestoreBlueprint
description: Firestore blueprint for Kasirku Tablet POS including inventory, customers, transactions, suppliers, attendances, and store settings

products.description: Store inventory items with multi-satuan conversion units and stock alerts

baseUnit.description: Atomic base unit e.g. PCS, KG

units.description: List of multi-unit pricing and conversion factors

customers.description: Registered retail and wholesale customers with points and debt balances

customerCategory.description: Customer category e.g. UMUM, REGULER, MEMBER, VIP

isMember.description: Official member status eligible to earn and redeem loyalty points

membershipId.description: Unique customer membership ID encoded into member QR code for fast checkout scan

transactions.description: Sales invoices, item breakdowns, payment methods, and points audit trail

cashierId.description: Staff ID who handled the sale

pointsEarned.description: Loyalty points accrued from this sale

notes.description: Optional transaction note or internal/customer remark

auditLogs.description: Administrator post-transaction edit audit log entries

customerRatingTags.description: Selected quick service quality feedback tags

customerRatedAt.description: Unix timestamp in ms when rating was submitted

items.description: List of sold items with units and prices

suppliers.description: Wholesale vendor directory and purchase order contacts

settings.description: Store information, thermal printer branding, loyalty configuration

storeFooterReceipt.description: Personalized 2-line receipt footer greeting or return policy

autoSendWhatsAppReceipt.description: Auto-send WhatsApp receipt notification after checkout

includeReceiptSummaryInAutoWa.description: Include transaction summary link in auto WhatsApp notification

includeLoyaltyPointsInAutoWa.description: Include loyalty point balance info in auto WhatsApp notification

useCustomWhatsAppTemplate.description: Use custom WhatsApp message template for receipts

customWhatsAppTemplate.description: Customizable WhatsApp receipt message template with placeholders

autoAdminLowStockWhatsApp.description: Automatically send WhatsApp alert to admin when multiple products hit minimum stock in a single day

adminWhatsAppNumber.description: Admin WhatsApp phone number for daily low-stock alert notifications

adminLowStockTriggerCount.description: Minimum number of distinct products hitting low stock in a single day before triggering admin WhatsApp alert

useCustomLowStockWhatsAppTemplate.description: Toggle custom WhatsApp template for low-stock alerts

customLowStockWhatsAppTemplate.description: Customizable WhatsApp low-stock alert template with product and stock placeholders

scheduledAdminLowStockWhatsApp.description: Scheduled recurring WhatsApp low-stock report settings (enabled, frequency, time, daysOfWeek, sendEvenIfAllSafe, includeOutOfStockSummary)

printerConnectionType.description: Thermal printer connection mode: BLUETOOTH or USB

autoPrintReceipt.description: Automatically trigger receipt print sequence after successful checkout

requireTransactionNote.description: Force cashier prompt for a Transaction Note before completing any sale

spendPerPoint.description: Spend threshold X in Rupiah to earn Y points

pointsPerSpend.description: Number of Y points earned per spendPerPoint threshold

autoApplyMaxPoints.description: Automatically apply maximum redeemable points discount on checkout when member has points

customPaymentMethods.description: Customizable list of active store payment methods including uploaded static QRIS JPGs

onlineStoreTagline.description: Storefront hero tagline displayed to online shoppers

onlineStoreDeliveryFee.description: Flat courier delivery fee for online orders in IDR

onlineStoreMinFreeDelivery.description: Minimum order subtotal for free local courier delivery in IDR

onlineStorePickupEnabled.description: Allow store pickup fulfillment for online orders

onlineStoreDeliveryEnabled.description: Allow local courier delivery fulfillment for online orders

categories.description: Product categories with customizable color badges for POS visual filtering

stock_opnames.description: Historical audit sessions and periodic physical count reconciliation records with unit and Rupiah discrepancies

items.description: List of audited products with physical vs system count

cashflows.description: Financial cashflow records for tracking daily store operational expenses (pengeluaran) and miscellaneous incomes (pemasukan)

paymentMethod.description: Payment source: CASH, TRANSFER_BCA, QRIS, LAINNYA

referenceNumber.description: Optional receipt or invoice reference code

recordedBy.description: Name of user who created the record

customer_categories.description: Master customer categories (e.g. UMUM, MEMBER, VIP, RESELLER, GROSIR) for special pricing rules

color.description: Color token e.g. purple, sky, emerald, amber

isSystemDefault.description: Whether category is a seeded default

online_orders.description: Customer-submitted online storefront orders pending confirmation, fulfillment, and POS settlement

orderCode.description: Human-friendly order tracking code e.g. ONL-20261116-4821

updatedAt.description: Last status update timestamp in ms

customerAddress.description: Delivery address when fulfillmentType is KIRIM_KURIR

paymentMethodType.description: CASH | QRIS | BANK_TRANSFER | CARD | COD | OTHER

status.description: MENUNGGU_KONFIRMASI | DIPROSES | SIAP_DIAMBIL | DIKIRIM | SELESAI | DIBATALKAN

items.description: List of ordered products/services with unit and variant

linkedTransactionId.description: POS transaction ID once finalized by cashier

linkedInvoiceNumber.description: POS invoice number once finalized by cashier

processedByName.description: Staff name who processed the order

cancelReason.description: Optional reason when order is cancelled
